name: WILKO Plastics, Inc.
old_description: Wilko Plastics specializes in custom injection molding and provides our customers with a variety of different molding solutions to suit each of their specific application needs. We manufacture automotive safety, A-class surface, functional, under-hood and fuel system components. We work with a broad range of thermoplastic materials while specializing in  tight tolerance and 2 shot products. Whether it is a simple or complex application Wilko Plastics has the molding knowledge and experience for it.
